title: Stability and error analysis of fully discrete original energy-dissipative and length-preserving scheme for the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation
summary: The Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation, regarded as a gradient flow with manifold constraint, is the fundamental model describing magnetization dynamics in ferromagnetic materials. It is well known that the normalized tangent plane method is able to simultaneously achieve the non-convex manifold constraint and original energy dissipation. However, the associated computational cost of this numerical approach is exceedingly high.
